::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [10 July 1870]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS  Mrs Katherine Wykes-Sneyd
:::

My dear [Pixie](people/person_539.qmd)
I don't know if you have heard how nearly [Goosedom](organizations/other_104.qmd)perished from exhaustion and how it has revived again, after throwing off a few idle members.  I did not throw you out because I thought we had had some very impossible questions lately, and we are going to keep them shorter and easier.

Will you send the answers when you get them to Bluebell ie

the Honble [Alethea Colborne](people/person_317.qmd)
Beechwood
Plympton

There are two more new members coming in

Facta non Verba.
[Rachel Deedes](people/person_433.qmd)
Bengeo Rectory
Hertford

[Phoebe Allen](people/person_25.qmd)
Finchcox
Kilndown
Staplehurst

your faithful
Mother Goose

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper with black-edged envelope postmarked Winchester 10 July and Tiverton 11 July 1870 andaddressed to Miss Mary Fursdon/ Fursdon/ Tiverton.
